title: A color can signal
hook: Color change can have more than one function.

knows: Animals have body structures and interact with their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: The schematic shows two differently colored animals facing one another. In some chameleons color change participates in communication, and temperature and other conditions can also matter; these colors are illustrative.

misconception: The observed arrangement has a different effect than the one shown.
objective: Two chameleons face one another. A color change in a display can serve which role?
